title: Glover Garden | See & Do | DISCOVER NAGASAKI/The Official Visitors' Guide

facts.fact: Glover Garden lies on the southern hillside with views across Nagasaki Harbor and includes the former Glover residence and relocated Western-style houses.
facts.excerpt: six other Western-style residences from the Meiji era

facts.fact: The site brings together the former Glover, Ringer and Alt residences and other relocated/restored buildings.
facts.excerpt: the former Ringer Residence, and the former Alt Residence
